items.design: A completely NEW mythic creature replacing the old hermit crab: a single coherent enormous aquatic monster made of hundreds of cursed golden shipwrecks. Horizontal side-three-quarter facing RIGHT, a fleet leviathan, NOT an animal covered by one boat. Its HEAD on the RIGHT is a great gilded flagship prow: broken carved figurehead horns, two heavy anchors form the lower jaw, eerie turquoise recessed eye/portholes. Its long body trailing LEFT consists of 5-7 large interlocked recognizable golden ship hulls layered like armored scales, with many tiny embossed wreck hull details implying hundreds of ships. Broken masts and torn black sails form the dorsal ridge; tail tapers into smaller wrecks ending with one large anchor. A continuous cohesive creature silhouette, no separate floating ship cloud. Old tarnished gold, black sails, deep teal corrosion, contained turquoise light inside hull gaps. Detailed soft fantasy illustration, legible large shapes, no external particle/glow clouds. NOT a crab, NOT a dragon with organic fish scales, no copied manta silhouette.
